definitions.explanation: The sixth day of the week. A short form of {土曜日|どようび}.

examples.japanese: {土曜|どよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧です。

examples.english: Let's go see a movie this Saturday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{土曜|どよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I go to the gym every Saturday morning.

notes:
The short form of ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧ (Saturday). Both forms are used interchangeably, but {土曜|どよう} is more common in compound expressions and abbreviated writing such as schedules and calendars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土曜|どよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: Saturday morning
- {土曜|どよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: Saturday night
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{土曜|どよう}: every Saturday
- {土曜|どよう}⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧: working on Saturday

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧: Saturday — the full form; slightly more formal
- ⟦{日曜|にちよう}→日曜：22837_nichiyou⟧: Sunday — the following day of the week
- {金曜|きんよう}: Friday — the preceding day of the week
